def build(spec, scale=None):
    """spec: {layer: [(head, unit_vector, a), ...]}; scale: {layer:{head:k}}. Rebuilds from originals, drops layers absent from spec."""
    want=set(spec)|set(scale or {})
    for nm in list(edited()):

    out={}
    for l in sorted(want):

        for h,u,a in spec.get(l,[]):
            Oh=N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]; N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]=Oh-a*(Oh@u)[:,None]@u[None,:]
        for h,k in (scale or {}).get(l,{}).items():
            N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]=N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]*k
        r=save_edit(nm,N.to(load_original(nm).dtype)); out[l]=round(r['rel_change'],4)
    return out

        elif o=='-': r=a-b
        elif o in '*x\u00d7': r=a*b
        else:
            if b==0: continue
            r=a/b
        if abs(r-c)<0.011*max(1,abs(r))*0.1+1e-6: ok+=1
        else: bad+=1
    return ok,bad

def ctx(name,p):
    if name=='eval': return fmt.replace('{problem}',p)
    if name=='nosuf': return "<bos><start_of_turn>user\n"+p+"<end_of_turn>\n<start_of_turn>model\n"
    if name=='qa': return "<bos>Question: "+p+"\nAnswer: "
    if name=='expert': return "<bos><start_of_turn>user\nYou are a brilliant, careful mathematician. Solve this exactly and correctly.\n\n"+p+"<end_of_turn>\n<start_of_turn>model\n"
    if name=='raw': return "<bos>"+p+"\n\n"

def build(spec, scale=None):
    """spec: {layer: [(head, unit_vector, a), ...]}; scale: {layer:{head:k}}. Rebuilds from originals, drops layers absent from spec."""
    want=set(spec)|set(scale or {})
    for nm in list(edited()):
        l=int(nm.split('.')[2])
        if l not in want: drop_edit(nm)
    out={}
    for l in sorted(want):
        nm=f'model.layers.{l}.self_attn.o_proj.weight'; O=load_original(nm).float(); N=O.clone()
        for h,u,a in spec.get(l,[]):
            Oh=N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]; N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]=Oh-a*(Oh@u)[:,None]@u[None,:]
        for h,k in (scale or {}).get(l,{}).items():
            N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]=N[:,h*256:(h+1)*256]*k
        r=save_edit(nm,N.to(load_original(nm).dtype)); out[l]=round(r['rel_change'],4)
    return out
